reason: We wash by hand at the tap and it works fine, power cut or not. Every rupee is going to the wedding, and ₹22,000 is more than a month of what we earn, all for a machine we have never needed.
objection: Power cuts don't stop my hands, so the battery fixes a problem I don't have. If I ever bought a washer, I'd get a cheap plain one and run it on the inverter we already have, not pay extra for a battery.
would_change_my_mind: If a basic washer came in under ₹10,000 after the wedding is paid for, and the women in the house were tired of hand-washing, I might think about one, but probably still without the battery.
